name: Benchmark Curve 6
definition: Identifies the benchmark against which the financial instrument is measured.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Either a swap spread or spread to benchmark depending upon order type. In case of a spread to benchmark, the price offset is expressed in terms of basis points relative to a benchmark - this can be a positive or a negative spread. In case of a swap spread, the price offset is a target spread for a swap.

BenchmarkIdentification.name: Benchmark Identification
BenchmarkIdentification.definition: Identification of a security by an ISIN.

BenchmarkPrice.name: Benchmark Price
BenchmarkPrice.definition: Identifies the price of the benchmark security.

BenchmarkCurveCurrency.name: Benchmark Curve Currency
BenchmarkCurveCurrency.definition: Identifies the currency used for the benchmark curve.

BenchmarkCurveName.name: Benchmark Curve Name
BenchmarkCurveName.definition: Identifies the name of the benchmark curve.

BenchmarkCurvePoint.name: Benchmark Curve Point
BenchmarkCurvePoint.definition: Identifies a point on a benchmark curve. The point can be stated via a combination of maturity month/year and coupon.
